policy.metric_interpretation: Recall is coverage of the supplied reference values. Precision is strict reference precision, not proven real-world precision when the key may be non-exhaustive.

1.scope: All categories explicitly present in answer_key.json are scored; omitted categories are not scored.
notes: Visual audit suggests some valid-looking values, including PI2889, are not listed. Treat apparent false positives as review candidates, not automatically as extraction errors.

2.scope: Only pid, pressure_control_valves (U-bend_pipe), and demineralized_water are in evaluation scope.
notes: The drawing visually shows PCV2826-PCV2829 with the same symbol treatment, while the supplied key lists PCV2828-PCV2829.

3.scope: No P&ID answer key. Evaluation is table-only and uses evaluation/table3_expected.json.
